note: Both sets accurately extract the key engineering claims regarding the NREL 5-MW turbine control system and filter properties. Set A is preferred because it is more concise; Set B contains multiple redundant claims (e.g., repeating the filter type, control system list, and torque controller operational range with negligible variations in conditions or entity names). Both sets miss defining the filter coefficient variables ($\alpha$, $T_s$, $f_c$) beyond input/output, but Set A's lower duplication rate makes it cleaner.
